change_summary: Add a provider-free cross-sport adversarial regression suite to existing CI; synthetic tests only, no changes to frozen CBB/CFB/MLB models, odds, graders, selections, or release policy.
assumptions: Synthetic fixtures test only incumbent code-path guards; they do not establish successful complete-denominator ledger integration.
CBB historical missing neutralSite coercion remains open in draft PR #424; these tests check only strict pregame slate admission, not the historical neutral fix.
MLB duplicate-key overwrites in load_keyed, missing/rejected-offer denominator, CFB filtered candidate ledger and player/team time-matching remain open work items.
No actual completed-game results, screenshots, private odds, prospective source authentication, calibration or CLV were used.
The governance golden pin is the repository's shared nine-case synthetic agent-safety fixture, not the new twelve cross-sport regressions.

baseline.metric: Cross-sport adversarial intake tests explicitly executed by generic CI
